FIELDS.NAME: Reel Haven Video Store
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Store Manager, 123 Main St, Suite 101, Springfield, IL 62701-1001, (555) 123-4567, johndoe@email.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Reel Haven Video Store specializes in the retail of physical and digital media, including DVDs, Blu-rays, and streaming services. Our operations are centered around providing a wide variety of movies, TV shows, and video games to cater to diverse customer preferences. We prioritize customer experience by offering personalized recommendations and hosting community events. All locations are equipped with security cameras covering all public areas, including cash registers and stockrooms, to deter theft and ensure safety. Employee training programs focus on customer service, safety protocols, and loss prevention, enabling staff to effectively manage operations and adhere to compliance standards. Additionally, we maintain stringent age-restriction enforcement for regulated media content and conduct regular inventory audits to manage stock efficiently. Our commitment to operational excellence and customer satisfaction drives our success in the dynamic media retail industry.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Theft of merchandise from the store on 02/20/2023, caused by a break-in. Total loss amount $1,500. Status: Claim submitted, pending review. Water damage from a leaking roof discovered on 03/15/2023, caused $1,000 in losses. Status: Addressed and repaired.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial Grade Safe, UL Listed, Class B, for secure storage of cash and sensitive media.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel present during operating hours and routine audits of security measures.
